missing.why: The Hebrew identifies Athaliah as the daughter of Omri.
The Hebrew explicitly calls Jehu the son of Nimshi without naming an intervening generation.
The Hebrew calls Ahaziah a son of Jehoshaphat, plainly identifying him as Jehoshaphat's descendant.

note: The relationships recorded elsewhere as granddaughter-of Omri and grandson-of Nimshi do not replace this chapter's explicit daughter-of and son-of statements. Ahaziah's relationship to Jehoshaphat is expressed as descendant-of because verse 1 identifies Jehoram as his father.
